PNG2BLP: the PNG-to-BLP converter from wowdev/pywowlib, folder blp/PNG2BLP/native
(https://github.com/wowdev/pywowlib/tree/master/blp/PNG2BLP/native). Its files carry no header; the
repository is under the MIT License (LICENSE in this folder, copied from the repository root:
https://github.com/wowdev/pywowlib/blob/master/LICENSE). Checked for Forge on 1 Nov 2026:
Png2Blp.cpp, Quantizer.cpp and BinaryWriter.cpp are byte-identical to that folder's copies.

Bundled inside it:
- libimagequant/ (Kornel Lesinski et al., https://github.com/ImageOptim/libimagequant): GPL-3.0-or-later
  for the changes and additions, pngquant's original licence for the base code. COPYRIGHT in that folder
  was added for Forge from upstream tag 2.12.2 (it was missing from the Noggit Red tree). GPL-3.0-or-later
  is compatible with Forge's GPL-3.0.
- libpng/ (libpng licence, libpng/LICENSE).
- pngpp/ (png++, BSD-3-Clause, pngpp/COPYING).
- zlib/ (zlib licence, zlib/LICENSE, taken from zlib.h).
- libtxc_dxtn/ (Roland Scheidegger, MIT-style licence in txc_dxtn.h).
